title: Kafka Consumer Lag — Message Queue Backpressure
symptom: Consumer group lag exceeds 100k messages; end-to-end processing latency degrades; producer-side timeouts appearing in application logs.
remediation_steps: Scale consumer deployment: kubectl scale deployment/<consumer-service> --replicas=6
If lag is from dead consumers, reset offsets to latest: kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server <broker> --group <group> --reset-offsets --to-latest --execute --topic <topic>
